text:
**Date:** The findings were released on 14 March 2031.

**Person:** Dr. Helena Voráčková, lead sedimentologist at the Sarnow Institute, presented the results.

**Figure:** Core samples showed 4.2 meters of continuous sediment layers, dating back roughly 11,000 years.

**Document/event:** The report rests on the peer-reviewed paper "Holocene Sediment Sequences of Ostrava Lake," published in the *Sarnow Institute Quarterly Review of Earth Sciences*.
